rationale: The assistant correctly identified the behaviour as normal ('These programmes are designed to save energy by using lower water temperatures and longer wash times') and steered the customer away from an unnecessary return, with no parts or escalation. It offered a sensible heating sanity check ('run a standard 60°C Cottons cycle') but never asked the simpler question of how long other programmes take, and in the second turn it missed the model's TimeManager/time-save option while offering marginal tips (liquid detergent, water pressure) that barely affect cycle length. Calibration was slightly overstated ('cannot be significantly shortened without changing the settings') but nothing was fabricated and the homeowner was well served overall.
